recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-15711 unless the build system stops using the current logical templates for the active Definition Pattern page.
issue_request: FHIR-15711 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 technical correction asking the Definition mappings page to use Pattern terminology instead of saying Resource definition/resource in the page title and first paragraph.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite an SVN revision, but git history shows the explicit application as fba2acf15a2c1bcf3e39c0cf69ae5525d5f704c5, 'GF#15711 - fix typo', imported from SVN @13391 on 2018-03-13. That commit changed the logical mappings template from resource wording to pattern wording and also aligned adjacent logical detail/content template headings. The SVN @13991 revision mentioned in Jira is an unrelated GF#16329 commit, so the Jira revision number appears mistyped.
additional_context: The logical templates were later moved from source/ to tools/templates/ without reverting the FHIR-15711 wording. In current build scope, source/fhir.ini lists definition as an active logical page and source/hierarchy.xml links the workflow Definition Pattern page. A separate combined-branch audit already decided adjacent FHIR-15712, which requested explanatory Definition-pattern text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current logical mappings template already sets the title to 'Pattern {xtitle} - Mappings' and describes mappings for the logical pattern.
